messages:
Marta: Heads up — last night's quantized-3b nightly had 6 timeout failures across linux-arm64 runners, sporadic. logs show worker stuck in wait_for_token() for >2m and then the harness kills it.
Oliver: saw the CI flaps too. only on a subset of runners and only when we run with workers>=8.
Jiang: I reproduced locally on Ubuntu 22.04 in a VM with --workers 16. can repro ~30–90m. Not every run but enough to be flaky. strace shows repeated futex calls with timed waits that look weird.
CI Bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood.example/ci/4829 (build/quantized-nightly-arm64) :x:
Marta: quick grep of the code — timebox.c builds an absolute timespec using clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) then calls pthread_cond_timedwait. pthread_cond_timedwait uses the cond's clock (default CLOCK_REALTIME) unless attr set, so if the system clock is adjusted the wait can sleep longer/shorter than expected.
Oliver: oof. so we mix monotonic and realtime. that explains nondeterministic timeouts if something adjusts clock or if there's small drift on the runner. the ARM images occasionally have ntp adjustments.
Jiang: attached the strace excerpt:
```
futex(0x7f8b2d0f2c40, FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE, 0, {tv_sec=1700, tv_nsec=0}) = ? EAGAIN (Resource temporarily unavailable)
--- hangs here ---
```
also gdb backtrace of the stuck thread shows:
```
#0  pthread_cond_timedwait (cond=0x..., mutex=0x..., abstime=0x...) at pthread_cond_wait.c:xxx
#1  0x400d1a in worker::wait_for_token()
#2  0x4012b3 in worker::main_loop()
```
Marta: I also noticed timerfd_create usage in worker_pool.cpp that doesn't close the fd on error path — could be leaking FDs and eventually changing scheduler behavior. but the main deterministic smell is the clock mismatch.
Oliver: Fix options:
- convert to pthread_condattr_setclock(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + pthread_cond_init with attr
- OR use clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME) everywhere (less desirable)
- OR switch to eventfd/timerfd with POLL and relative timeouts
Jiang: I'm prototyping pthread_condattr_setclock in a branch. local quick patch passes 200 runs without hitting the timeout so far. also closed a couple of timerfd leaks in the same patch.
Marta: can you paste the minimal change?
Oliver: snippet:
```
pthread_condattr_t attr;
pthread_condattr_init(&attr);
pthread_condattr_setclock(&attr, CLOCK_MONOTONIC);
pthread_cond_init(&cond, &attr);
// replace pthread_cond_timedwait with same abstime computed from CLOCK_MONOTONIC
pthread_condattr_destroy(&attr);
```
Jiang: opened PR #4829 with the pthread attr change + timerfd close + a small unit test that simulates a forward clock jump and asserts the timebox still fires. running CI now.
CI Bot: CI started for PR 4829 — checks: unit, integration, nightly-sim.
Marta: once PR is green let's cherry-pick to release/2025.03. add a small integration harness job that runs the quantized-3b eval with --workers 16 x 4 in a matrix to catch regressions early.
Oliver: agree. also add a comment in timebox.c explaining clock choice and why monotonic is required.
Jiang: FYI, while prototyping I found an unrelated flaky: when worker ctor fails after timerfd_create the destructor path didn't close the fd resulting in rare EMFILE. I fixed that too in the PR. might reduce other flakiness.
Marta: nice. can you also add a short reproduction note in the PR description with the exact CLI I used: `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model quantized-3b --iters 2000 --workers 16 --seed 42` and the strace command: `strace -ff -o /tmp/strace.%p ./bin/harness ...`
Jiang: done. PR 4829 description contains repro steps + gdb backtrace + strace snippets. CI shows unit+integration green, nightly-sim running.
CI Bot: nightly-sim completed: passed ✅
Marta: awesome — merging once CI finishes full matrix. will monitor next nightly. thanks y'all. :raised_hands:
Oliver: gonna add a small tech note in the eng-ml wiki about common pitfalls between monotonic vs realtime for future onboarding.
Jiang: will cherry-pick to release after merge and cut a small patch release if no regressions.
Marta: marking this thread for follow-up in postmortems if we see recurrence.
CI Bot: PR 4829 merged into main (commit 7c9a2f2).
